home_pc_instructions._doc: How a Home-PC session consumes this handoff. No chat history required.
home_pc_instructions.1_fetch: git fetch origin qa/work-pc && git show origin/qa/work-pc:qa/HANDOFF_STATE.json
home_pc_instructions.2_read_queue: git show origin/qa/work-pc:qa/BUG_QUEUE.json — work P0 -> P1 -> P2 -> P3 in that order.
home_pc_instructions.3_read_bug_detail: git show origin/qa/work-pc:qa/bugs/<BUG_ID>.md — full repro, six truth checks, evidence, regression path, implementation recommendation.
home_pc_instructions.4_implement: Fix on master. Run the linked regression to confirm it now passes.
home_pc_instructions.5_publish_fix_report: Write qa/home-pc-handoff/fixes/<BUG_ID>.json on the qa/home-pc-handoff branch with: bug_id, fix_commit, implementation_summary, implementation_tests, status='READY_FOR_RETEST', timestamp. Do NOT edit qa/BUG_QUEUE.json - it is Work-PC-owned.
home_pc_instructions.6_never: Never set CLOSED. Only an independent Work-PC retest closes a defect.

work_pc_resume_instructions: Read qa/runner/QA_DIRECTOR_BOOT.md, then qa/HANDOFF_STATE.json, qa/BUG_QUEUE.json, qa/CAPABILITY_INVENTORY.json. Remaining C001: Org Business Units (dual-model), Projects CRUD, Goals, Tasks edit, multi-action commands, remaining cascade attacks, reload/fresh-session truth. Then supervisor implementation.
